route_semantics: All32 fixed before quotes. Route0: split Q nominal pUSD for fixed question0, keep YES0, convert NO0 to YES1..4, sell all five YES; gross margin Q*(sum bids-1). Routes1..31: buy Q of each NO in nonempty S, convert to (|S|-1)Q collateral plus Q YES for each question outside S, sell complement YES; margin Q*((|S|-1)+sum complement bids-sum selected asks). Mask31 is previous fullNO reference; other30 proper subsets are a new prospective family. No residual YES assumed discarded or valued subjectively. Actual source/deployment equivalence and conversions unproved.
sampling: ONE run. Claim fixes wall+monotonic anchor2s ahead before HTTP; slot k0..14 starts anchor+4*k. More than250mslate is missed, never rescheduled. Each slot at most one fixed ten-token POST. First transport/resource/JSON/identity failure stops future HTTP and marks remaining slots unavailable. After ten-token identity validation, empty required NOasks/YESbids or invalid numeric/tick/hash/timestamp/crossed books make a slot unavailable and continue calendar. Freshness/coherence failure alone is diagnostic and continues. Subsequent scheduled slots are not retries. No fallback/redirect/proxy/pagination/sign-driven stopping or size/event substitution.
identity_validation: Exactly ten response objects: each fixed market NO then YES request token appears once, matching condition_id and neg_risk true. No unknown/extra/missing/duplicate token IDs. Verify all immutable chainv2 and inherited helper/source pins. Requests use no economic selector.
book_validation: Strict bounded JSON. price,size,tick_size,min_order_size must be bounded nonnegative plain-decimal strings with at most6 fractional digits and32 total chars; reject signs/exponents/nonfinite. Require0<price<=1,size>0,tick>0<=1,min_order_size>0; price is an integer tick multiple. Both sides required arrays <=5000 levels each; validate levels, normalize order in memory (do not assume wire ordering) and derive best ask=min ask price and best bid=max bid price. NO asks and YES bids are economic inputs; all other sides are integrity-only (maxbid>=minask invalid). Require nonempty bounded hash string <=128 chars. Require nonempty NO asks and YES bids for the common32-route family; missing economic side means all routes unavailable for that slot. Empty integrity-only side is allowed. No depth walk, quantity choice, fill model or parameter selection.
time_validation: timestamp must be10-digit Unix-seconds or13-digit Unix-milliseconds decimal string; record inferred unit and original value. The docs call this snapshot time without specifying a unit, so conversion/freshness remain explicitly interpretive. Record local request start/end UTC and monotonic duration, plus bounded HTTP Date if present. For diagnostics define fresh/coherent only if each timestamp is no later than receipt+250ms, no older than5s at receipt, and cross-ten-book timestamp span<=500ms. These criteria are frozen; neither common response nor freshness proves atomic/executable liquidity.

bound.unit: Conditional nominal pUSD accounting, using official docs assertion that all Polymarket trading uses pUSD; individual book objects have no unit field. No real USD/USDC redemption/equivalence assertion.
bound.arithmetic: Exact Decimal from bounded plain strings, all32 route margins per common valid slot. Zero fees/gas/latency/setup, no rebate/dust subsidy. Buy costs can only rise and sell proceeds only fall with depth, so margin<=0 rejects positive equal-Q displayed taker margin under this conditional conversion model at these recorded quotes for any Q>0. Fee deductions cannot improve this upper bound.
bound.decision: Preserve15 slots and480 planned route-slots, missing/invalid and freshness separately. Field-valid nonpositive recorded routes can be conditionally rejected at their recorded prices; positive margin is only a necessary candidate, never paper profit. No common-time statement on asynchronous books. An all-family observed-set rejection requires all15 field-valid fresh/coherent sets and all480 margins<=0; no continuous-interval/general absence claim. Continue whole calendar regardless of signs.
bound.remaining_gates: Deployed-source conversion equivalence, actual successful conversion, authoritative fee rounding/units/delay,depth/minimums,fillable five-leg acquisition/settlement/partial-fill liquidation,gas/setup/dust disposition and inclusion are unproved. None is needed for this conditional zero-cost necessary-condition screen; all remain before a profit claim.

retention: Bounded gzip JSONL of original response bodies encoded base64 plus request/receipt metadata; no plaintext raw file. Each attempted or missed slot checkpoints atomically. Only selected NO asks and YES bids used economically; other sides integrity only, last_trade_price/history/rewards never used. Compact derived summary/terminal/supervisor; preserve partial trace and all missing slots on every stop. Default dry mode0HTTP,required --run --plan-sha256 exactpins, refuse existing output. Derived book hash and HTTP Date use SHA256 fingerprints; originals remain in raw trace. Interrupted attempts are unknown, never zero.
implementation: Own only scripts/polymarket_subset_conversion_books.py and tests/test_polymarket_subset_conversion_books.py. Leave uncommitted. Pure imports of unchanged old modules allowed with pins; no global mutation or monkeypatch in production, no old live gate/output. Root owns plan. Hardcode ten-token identities, caps/output/routes. Default dry0HTTP; root review exactpins+commit before ONE run. Seven focused economic/resource/timing/failure synthetic families sufficient; no live API tests. Compact summary to remain<=98304 total derived old+pending+supervisor/receipts, not merely per-file. Preserve unknown interrupted attempts.
run_gate: Root completed source, math, cap and failure-path review. After exact frozen commit, one --run --plan-sha256 invocation only. Preserve all15slots/480route-slots. No retries or quote-driven substitutions. Source/terminal/supervisor verification required for recorded-set conclusions; freshness remains separate and no execution/profit follows.

verification.failure_gates: Failed post-run source check or incomplete sampling disables economic conclusions. Unretained response cannot support its slot; preserve earlier retained slots and receipt hashes. Successful supervisor and terminal required in addition to summary.
